strategyName: ZenBlade Session ORB + VWAP Reclaim v2

currentObservation.backtestResult: Promising but too small: 7 to 10 trades per scenario. Four of five variants were net positive after fees/slippage, but no scenario met minimum sample requirements.

lastDecision: Do not integrate into Railway or paper loop. V2 produced the first promising Session ORB/VWAP result, but the sample is too small for a strategy decision. Freeze parameters and run a larger-history robustness test before any further tuning.

priorFindingFromV1.interpretation: V1 suggested a weak gross edge in sweep -> VWAP reclaim/rejection. V2 narrowed the setup and improved net results, but its first sample remains too small.

interpretation: All tested variants had positive gross PnL.
Four of five variants had positive net PnL after fees and slippage.
ETH contributed most of the positive result; BTC remained weak in several variants.
Short-only rejection was stronger than long-only reclaim on this sample.
The best combined quality scenario had PF 2.36 but only 10 trades.
No candidate passed because the sample is below the minimum robustness threshold.

researchHypothesis.type: focused session-based sweep and VWAP reclaim/rejection strategy
researchHypothesis.primaryIdea: Wait for a liquidity sweep outside the session opening range, then enter only if price reclaims or rejects VWAP with volume/impulse confirmation.
whyDifferentFromV1: Removes broad ORB breakout and ORB retest scenarios
Focuses only on the setup that had positive gross PnL in v1
Starts with ETH and BTC only
Tests ETH-only, late-US-only, long-only, and short-only variants
Keeps low trade frequency and strict risk controls
riskControls: one trade per session per symbol
cooldown day after a losing trade

knownProblems: The first promising result is based on only 7 to 10 trades per scenario
The result may be specific to the most recent approximately 22-day window
ETH carried most of the positive result while BTC was weak in several subsets
Short-only and ETH-only subsets may overfit the small sample
Session definitions may not remain stable across market regimes
A larger-history run may reduce or remove the apparent edge
blockedChanges: Do not add Session ORB VWAP v2 to Railway paper loop yet
Do not use OKX API keys
Do not use martingale or increase position size after losses
Do not tune parameters again before the larger-history robustness run
Do not declare success from 7 to 10 trades
Do not expand to illiquid altcoins

successCriteriaForRobustness.minimumTrades: at least 25 to 40 trades in the leading scenario
successCriteriaForRobustness.drawdown: controlled and ideally below 12% of 1000 USDT paper balance
successCriteriaForRobustness.windowStability: results should not depend on one recent short period
successCriteriaForRobustness.paperLoopDecision: even a positive larger-history result still requires window or walk-forward validation before paper integration

nextResearch: Compare the larger-history results with the 6000-candle baseline
Check whether ETH-only, combined quality, and short-only remain positive
If the larger-history result remains positive, add window or walk-forward validation
Only after robustness checks consider a disabled-by-default paper module
